Come hungry.

Aloha Ohana! We're Island Grubz On The Go: a husband and wife from Oʻahu, cooking the flavors we grew up with from one tiny kitchen in Salem.

Start with our Garlic Chicken, crispy, sweet, savory and garlicky. It's our top seller for a reason. Kalbi short ribs come straight off the grill. Can't pick? The Grubz Pack: Kalbi, three slices of sweet soy glazed Spam, and katsu or garlic chicken. Every plate gets two scoops of rice and our classic Hawaiian mac salad.

Find the truck in The Fussy Duck parking lot, 3170 Commercial St SE. Tuesday to Saturday, 11am to 6pm, or until we sell out. Saturdays move fast, so pull up early.

Meet the Ohana

From Oʻahu to Salem, with aloha.

“We came with aloha, and our community met us with it.”Island Grubz, January 1, 2026

We're a husband and wife, born and raised on Oʻahu. When we moved from Hawaiʻi to Oregon, we brought the flavors we grew up with. On May 30, 2025, we opened our window for the very first time, in The Fussy Duck parking lot. Everything is made fresh to order, except our Kalua Pig, which slow-roasts for five hours. Mahalo to Ms. Risa and The Fussy Duck for giving us a place to call home, and next up is The Reed, downtown.
